title: sdk: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go; bump versions
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: SDK parity and ergonomics inconsistencies were causing subtle auth/retry differences and streaming ergonomics divergence across languages. This PR standardizes token refresh and retry semantics, consolidates streaming client helpers, and aligns public surface and type ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go.

What this PR does:
- Introduces a shared RetryPolicy contract (idempotent vs non-idempotent) implemented in each SDK with consistent backoff defaults.
- Unifies auth token refresh semantics: background refresh + singleflight to avoid thundering herd; explicit TokenProvider interface compatibility across SDKs.
- Streaming ergonomics: Python async iterator + context-manager, TS async iterable + readable stream adapter, Go chan-based iterator with Close() and error propagation. Adds helper utilities for chunked/resumeable streaming.
- Fixes parity bugs: missing error propagation on stream cancel, inconsistent max_retries behavior, discrepancies in header forwarding for delegated auth.
- Bumps package versions: python 1.5.0, typescript 2.0.3, go 0.9.1 and updates CHANGELOGs.
- Adds unit and integration tests covering token refresh races, retry backoff boundaries, and stream cancellation behavior.

Checklist:
- [x] Design and cross-language API proposals (ENG-2120)
- [x] Implementation in Python/TS/Go
- [x] Tests and CI updates
- [x] Changelog and version bumps
- [x] Docs snippets updated

Notes: Kept breaking changes minimal; adapters provided to preserve older call sites. Detailed rationale and design notes are in the linked Linear items.
